titulo: The extra line before the terminal
subtitulo: Ask for the bill, verify the total, remove an unauthorised tip and keep the receipt
cena: The plates have been cleared for five minutes, and the terminal is already halfway to the table before a single number has actually been shown to you.
frasePiso: Before the card touches the terminal, you can make the amount visible, identify an extra line and authorise only what you chose.

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Restaurants and bars in Mexico must display prices clearly, in national currency and including taxes, and must provide a receipt.
fatosDatados.fonte: Profeco — direitos em restaurantes e bares (15 fev. 2026)

fatosDatados.afirmacao: A tip in Mexico is voluntary and cannot be demanded or included on the bill without the diner's consent; an unrequested charge is treated as an abusive practice.
fatosDatados.fonte: Profeco — revisão da conta e gorjeta voluntária (4 jul. 2026); Profeco — cargo extra sem autorização (2 jan. 2025)

steps.pt: Recall the airport payment question — bring it here too, but don't let the terminal outrun the bill.

steps.promptPt: Recall B06. Before ordering, ask whether you can pay by card. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: PWEH-doh pah-GAHR kohn tar-HEH-tah
steps.pt: Can I pay by card?
Meal's done. The frame here is ¿me trae, plus whatever you want brought — starting with the bill.

steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the bill, please?

steps.promptPt: The plates are clear but no bill has arrived. Ask for it. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the bill, please?
Of course, I'll bring it now.
Prices should show in pesos, taxes included. No need to catch spoken numbers — ask to see it if it runs past your ear.

steps.pinyin: kwahl ehs el toh-TAHL
steps.pt: What is the total?

steps.promptPt: The bill has several lines. Ask for the final amount. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: kwahl ehs el toh-TAHL
steps.pt: What is the total?
It's eight hundred forty pesos.

steps.pinyin: meh loh PWEH-deh mohs-TRAHR por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you show it to me, please?

steps.promptPt: You did not catch the amount. Do not guess or practise arithmetic aloud; ask to see it. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh loh PWEH-deh mohs-TRAHR por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you show it to me, please?
Your finger stops on an unfamiliar line — don't accuse, don't pay yet. Ask what it is, and ask for removal if unauthorised.

steps.pinyin: keh ehs EHS-teh KAHR-goh
steps.pt: What is this charge?

steps.promptPt: There is an extra line on the bill. Point to it and ask what it is. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: keh ehs EHS-teh KAHR-goh
steps.pt: What is this charge?
It's the tip.

steps.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: noh ow-toh-ree-SEH EHS-teh KAHR-goh PWEH-deh kee-TAHR-loh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?
steps.tts: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?

steps.promptPt: The server says the unrequested line is the tip. State that you did not authorise it and ask for removal. Speak now.
steps.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: noh ow-toh-ree-SEH EHS-teh KAHR-goh PWEH-deh kee-TAHR-loh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?
Yes, I'll remove it.
Removing that line doesn't forbid a voluntary tip — choose your amount after correction, no fixed percentage.

steps.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.
steps.pinyin: KYEH-roh ah-greh-GAHR EHS-tah kahn-tee-DAHD deh proh-PEE-nah
steps.pt: I want to add this amount as a tip.
steps.tts: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.

steps.promptPt: The corrected bill is in front of you. Show the amount you chose on your phone and say you want to add that amount as a tip. Speak now.
steps.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.
steps.pinyin: KYEH-roh ah-greh-GAHR EHS-tah kahn-tee-DAHD deh proh-PEE-nah
steps.pt: I want to add this amount as a tip.
All right. I'll add it.
Now the total is what you approved. Bring the terminal, compare its screen to the corrected bill, then pay.

steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the card terminal, please?

steps.promptPt: The corrected bill is ready and you are keeping the card with you. Ask for the terminal. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the card terminal, please?
Yes, here it is.
Close the loop with evidence — ask for the receipt and keep it. It's the last checkable artifact in the scene.

steps.es: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh PWEH-deh dahr el reh-SEE-boh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you give me the receipt, please?
steps.tts: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?

steps.promptPt: Payment went through. Ask for the receipt before you leave. Speak now.
steps.es: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh PWEH-deh dahr el reh-SEE-boh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you give me the receipt, please?
Of course, here you are.

steps.promptPt: A second word for the same thing. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh dah lah NOH-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can I have the bill, please?

steps.promptPt: You want to split the payment across two methods. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: PWEH-doh pah-GAHR lah mee-TAHD kohn tahr-HEH-tah
steps.pt: Can I pay half by card?

steps.es: ¿Me trae la cuenta, por favor? ¿Cuál es el total? ¿Qué es este cargo? ¿Me trae la terminal, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR. kwahl ehs el toh-TAHL. keh ehs EHS-teh KAHR-goh. meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Shadow the bill, total, extra-charge and terminal sequence.
steps.tts: ¿Me trae la cuenta, por favor? ¿Cuál es el total? ¿Qué es este cargo? ¿Me trae la terminal, por favor?

steps.pt: B14 complete. Bill before terminal, total visible, unknown line questioned, your tip chosen, receipt kept.

aprofundar.titulo: The bill is an approval surface

secoes.titulo: Pesos and taxes are already part of the display
secoes.corpo: Restaurant prices should be shown in Mexican pesos and include taxes. A dollar figure may also appear, but the national-currency price remains the anchor.

secoes.titulo: A voluntary tip needs your choice
secoes.corpo: Profeco states that a tip cannot be demanded or included without the diner's consent. Removing an unauthorised line and choosing a voluntary amount are separate actions.

secoes.titulo: Show numbers when speech is brittle
secoes.corpo: B14 trains receptive numbers. On the productive side, point to the bill, terminal or phone; the result matters more than performing arithmetic in Spanish.

secoes.titulo: The terminal waits for the bill
secoes.corpo: Ask for the bill, inspect it, then bring the terminal into the scene. Compare the corrected total and keep the receipt as the final checkable artifact.

permissao: You are allowed to stop a payment mid-motion to ask about a line you don't recognise. Pointing at the bill before the terminal arrives is not distrust or stinginess — it is the one moment in the whole meal where slowing down is exactly the right move.
espelho: Checking a restaurant bill before tapping a card is a habit most people already have at home, at least occasionally — B14 isn't asking you to be more suspicious abroad than you are at home, it's asking you to keep the same habit you'd already use if a receipt looked off in your own language.

fichasCulturais.sinal: The bill arrives with a line you didn't request, and the server is already standing there with the card terminal, waiting.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: Questioning it now will hold up the line, or it's probably just how it's done here.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: A tip in Mexico is voluntary by regulation, and a charge added without your consent is treated as an improper practice, not a normal local custom — the pressure to just accept it and move on is about timing, not about you being wrong to ask.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Point to the specific line and ask ¿Qué es este cargo? before the terminal changes anything, then ask for it to be removed if it wasn't authorised.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You pay exactly what you approved, and you can still add a voluntary tip of your own choosing right afterward — asking doesn't cost you the option to tip.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not a reason to question a tip line you did explicitly agree to earlier, or one clearly marked as optional on a menu you already saw — the rule is about unauthorised charges, not tipping itself.

clique.desconto: Nobody taught you three ways to make something come to you. You kept one opening and changed only what you wanted brought.
clique.piso: Next time something you need is sitting behind a counter, you won't wait to be offered it. You'll ask for it by name.
